summary: The change casts the Gmail release retry timestamp to BIGINT for PostgreSQL, logs typed metadata without secrets when OAuth credential resolution fails, and removes duplicate connection cards within one turn of the session view. The durable run now passes, and all 6 changed executable lines are covered. F1 is resolved: the test comment now says that only runs with `HALO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set test the PostgreSQL regression, and that default SQLite runs check only scheduling. The change is ready.
